hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *CHANGELOG.md|*.release-please-manifest.json) echo 'Release-managed file: change it through release-please, not by hand.' >&2; exit 2;; esac

i=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ "$f" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/package.json" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' "$i" | jq -e --arg v "$(jq -r .version "$f")" 'def ver: (capture("\"version\"\\s*:\\s*\"(?<v>[^\"]*)\"") | .v) // null; if .tool_input.content then ((.tool_input.content | fromjson? | .version) // $v) != $v else ((.tool_input.old_string // "") | ver) != ((.tool_input.new_string // "") | ver) end' >/dev/null && { echo 'The version is release-please managed: never hand-edit it.' >&2; exit 2; }; true

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s\n' "$c" | grep -qE -- '--no-verify|(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*(rm|pnpm)([[:space:]]|$)' && { echo 'Blocked: no --no-verify, no rm (mv into a mktemp -d dir), no pnpm (npm only).' >&2; exit 2; }; true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */src/runtime/workers/*.ts) grep -nE '^(import|export)\b' "$f" && echo 'Worker must stay import-free (classic worker).' >&2 && exit 2;; */src/*.ts|*/src/*.vue) grep -n 'console\.' "$f" && echo 'The module never logs. Remove console calls.' >&2 && exit 2;; esac; true
